declared: before any capture of the campaign exists; this file's git commit and sha256 are the declaration
comparison: for each set S in {B, T, R1, R2, TR}: Geant4 captures of S (reference) against the bank of set A replayed at the entrance states of S's primaries in S's placement (candidate), in the global frame, per class (incoming species and kinetic energy); replay in float64 and in float32
binning_note: [lo, hi, n]: n equal bins between lo and hi plus an underflow and an overflow bin; log10 of a deposit, energy or time at or below 1e-12 enters the underflow

criteria.name: shapes
criteria.note: two-sample chi2 (ROOT UU) p-value, Bonferroni over every tested (class, observable) of the set

criteria.name: mean_edep
criteria.observable: mean total deposit per trial, worst class
criteria.note: candidate / reference with the independent-sample error of the class furthest from 1 in errors

pass: every criterion for every set and both replay dtypes; B (nominal) is the null of the procedure itself and must pass like the others
